A firm earns EBIT=200EBIT = 200EBIT=200 every year forever. The required return is 10%10\%10% and the corporate tax rate is 30%30\%30%.

By how much does firm value rise when debt grows from 000 to 400400400?

  • The MM Theorem: Does Capital Structure Change Value?
Show solution

  1. The rise in firm value equals the rise in the tax shield: ΔV=TcΔD=0.30×400=120\Delta V = T_c \Delta D = 0.30 \times 400 = 120ΔV=Tc​ΔD=0.30×400=120.

  2. Unlevered value is 200×(1−0.30)/0.10=1400200 \times (1 - 0.30) / 0.10 = 1400200×(1−0.30)/0.10=1400, so with debt of 400400400 the value is 152015201520.

Answer

It rises by 120120120, from 140014001400 to 152015201520
